description: This file sets up a service worker for prefetching and performance optimizations in a Qwik-based web application. It imports the setup function from Qwik's service worker module, initializes the service worker, and handles lifecycle events such as 'install' and 'activate'.

methods.name: setupServiceWorker
methods.description: Initializes the Qwik service worker to enable prefetching and other functionalities.
